name: isURLFilteringProfileEnabled
definition: Every enabled allow rule that can carry web traffic (application any, web-browsing or ssl) has a URL Filtering profile.
population: enabled allow rules whose application is any, web-browsing or ssl
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the security rulebase and profile groups showing every enabled allow rule that can carry web traffic carrying a URL Filtering profile.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Which rules face the internet is not in the configuration, so the web-capable test is by application (any, web-browsing, ssl); a profile's category actions are not read. vsys1 only.
